text_block_list.text: One day, as our time with <chrname> had reached a milestone, I arrived at the training course.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —*Haa*—*haa*. ...Number oooone!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, now. A paced run is not meant for competing over rankings, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... *cough*, *wheeze*! All... fini... shed...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Tsuru-chan, are you okay? Geez, I keep telling you not to push yourself too hard!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We still have plenty of time. Guard against arrogance and rashness—let us catch our breath calmly before moving to the next exercise.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
...*Inhale*, *exhale*. *Inhale*, *exhale*.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, excuse me! When I thought about training together with everyone, I just got carried away...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm... But that is likely what bore fruit. The growth shown by you two lately is truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Relying solely upon individual strength inherently has its limits. United in heart and effort—there are heights that can only be reached when we join forces and polish one another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I hope you two will continue striving for such heights, honing yourselves together.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...'You two'~~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We've been polishing each other till we're sparkling clean *together with you, Prez*!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ! Ah, that is a bad habit of mine. I unconsciously look at things from a detached perspective.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, what I have gained from running alongside you both is immense as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Teio's fighting spirit, always charging straight into races—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And Tsuyoshi's sincere diligence, tirelessly forging herself. Both shine brilliantly and never cease to push me forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Your daily dedication grants me immense strength as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ugh, President Rudolf... Tsuyoshi is deeply moved!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! But you can't let your guard down, okay, Prez?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If we keep growing at this rate, we'll leave you in the dust in no time!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's our Teio-chan! Alright, I'm gonna fire myself up too~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, then first, a match between the two of us! Next up is ten slope dashes!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Nunun! I won't lose~! Let's go, Tsuyoshi! Don't give up, Tsuyoshi~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Truly, swift hares and brilliant dragons... Fufu, immensely dependable indeed.
Having finished their break, the three took off running once more. The harmonious sight left a lasting impression on me.
